content: .{@-वासस्@} {%a.%} .²1 ill-dressed. .²2 naked. --({%m.%}) <ab>N.</ab> of a very irascible saint or Ṛṣi, son of Atri and Anasūyā. (He was very hard to please, and he cursed many a male and female to suffer misery and degradation. His anger, like that of Jamadagni, has become almost proverbial.)
